create_DummyPredictor: create a DummyPredictor instance from a DummyPredictorConfig to generate fake predictions with EOS tokens
run_DummyPredictor_call: run the DummyPredictor on prompts to return fake Prediction objects with empty text and token zero
create_DummyJudge: create a DummyJudge instance from a DummyJudgeConfig to evaluate prediction outcomes by averaging embeddings
run_DummyJudge_call: run the DummyJudge on prompts to compute mean prediction embeddings and return judge predictions
test_DummyPredictor_from_config: test the DummyPredictor.from_config static method to instantiate a predictor from its config class
